cohort: The study included 108 primiparous women (54 in the experimental group, 54 in the control group) who presented to an antenatal clinic between February 2015 and March 2016.
finding: The pregnancy Pilates-assisted childbirth preparation training significantly reduced childbirth fear and positively impacted several neonatal outcomes, including mode of birth, Apgar score, newborn body weight, and early mother-newborn interactions, in primiparous women.
mod_finding: The training group experienced positive effects on mode of birth and rates of planned or unplanned cesarean births compared to the control group.
